## Conductor / “All Aboard” (G4)

The pocket-watch-carrying Friendship Express conductor: a pale bluish-gray Earth-pony stallion with a very dark gray mane, amber eyes, a railway uniform, and a **pocket-watch cutie mark**. He calls departures, checks tickets, and occasionally serves snacks. **Steamer** is a different, tan-coated train-driver pony. [Character and naming reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Friendship_Express_train_conductors).

**Name and continuity.** “All Aboard” is a **fan/wiki placeholder**, drawn from his recurring call, not an established proper name in the *Friendship Is Magic* TV credits. Credits/scripts call him **Conductor**, **Conductor Pony**, **Ticket Agent**, or **Porter Pony**; Gameloft's licensed mobile game uses **Conductor** and describes his punctuality and watch cutie mark. [Gameloft character entry](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Conductor). Some fan art calls him **“Ringo,”** comparing him with Ringo Starr's Mr. Conductor; that is a fandom nickname, **not** a crossover identity or official name.

**Where to remember him.** In *The Last Roundup* he calls Applejack's Canterlot train ([episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Last_Roundup)); in *Just for Sidekicks* he refuses to let Spike board with the pets without tickets and chaperones ([transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Just_for_Sidekicks)). He also works the train in *One Bad Apple*, *Party Pooped*, *Hearthbreakers* (as a snack-selling porter), *Uncommon Bond* (ticket agent), *Surf and/or Turf* (announcing the Mount Aris stop; [transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Surf_and_or_Turf)), and *Growing Up Is Hard to Do*. He appears in IDW *Friends Forever* #4 and *Legends of Magic* #6.

**Speaking/voices.** **He speaks**, not just a silent background extra. Credited or identified English performers include **Peter New** (including *Just for Sidekicks* and *Surf and/or Turf*), **Garry Chalk** (*Party Pooped*, credited “Gary”), **Ian Hanlin** (*Uncommon Bond*), and **Gavin Langelo** (*Rarity's Biggest Fan* short). An Andrew Francis “Train Conductor” credit in other scenes does **not** securely identify this pony rather than Steamer.
